route.hint: Use the same inferred-marker setting and choose separate routes, 1 and 2. Open only your numbered chests. Chests and key rooms are split with at most 1 difference. Orange dashed paths require a key; spawns vary.
supplements.hint: Dashed rings mark inferred room-template candidates, not guaranteed spawns. The mage portrait marks a boss candidate.
rewards.hint: These are raw settings. Chest groups are randomized and candidate locations may overlap.
data.hint: Select a map manually or use recognition. Fog and similar rooms can affect results. Spawns are not guaranteed; floors and opened chests are not detected.
notice: Markers show possible spawns. Difficulty filters nests and their monsters; other markers retain all candidate groups.
recognition.hint: Recognition stops once the dungeon is locked. Toggle it off and on to recognize the next dungeon.
tracking.hint: After selecting a map, you can turn off recognition and enable tracking. Tracking also works with manual map selection.
capture.hint: Cyan is the minimap; yellow is the M-map. Select a region and drag in the preview. Changing regions resets recognition.
overlay.openHint: Open overlay; use F1 to hide or show it
overlay.closeHint: F1 hides/shows; click to close the overlay and keep the main window

log.hint: Write diagnostic logs only when enabled
help.map: Choose a dungeon, difficulty and markers. Scroll to zoom and drag to pan. Icon size ranges from 75–250%. Markers and filters sync to the overlay.
help.route: Either portal can be the start; changing it preserves chest assignments. Blue is the main route, orange dashes require a key, and gold dots indicate stairs. Numbers show visit order, not opened chests. Gold chests are not assigned.
help.overlay: Overlay opens a transparent map. F1 hides/shows it; × closes it. Drag the move handle to reposition; size is 50–150%. Use windowed or borderless game mode. Press Alt first if the cursor is locked.
help.recognition: Enable recognition, press M in-game and fully zoom out. Tracking uses the minimap; close the M-map first. Mint dots show estimated position; a gray ring means no update for 1.5 seconds. ◎ centers the player.
help.settings: Map, difficulty, filters, routes, sidebar and language are saved across updates for the same Windows account. DEBUG LOG is off by default; enabling writes diagnostics. Disabling leaves existing logs intact.
